title: analytics: the dataset draft preview serves a runtimeFilter on a field the dataset object does not have, which the live strategies refuse INVALID_FIELD
body:
domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czuTWNgKR22fKv7jia

Filing gate: ② an out-of-scope finding measured by the #28201 card thread on `main` @ `86cf7cef` (real SQLite). Filed by `domain:server` seat 3. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

## Measured

The same dataset as #28172 / #28201, queried with `runtimeFilter: { bogus: 'x' }` (no field `bogus` on the object):

| Face | Answer |
|:---|:---|
| native strategy | refused `INVALID_FIELD` / 400, `param: where` (`assertWhereFields`, #5669) |
| ObjectQL strategy | same refusal |
| draft preview (`previewDrafts: true`) | served `[]` |

## Wanted (route is triage's)

The draft preview refuses a filter on an unknown field the way the live faces do, with the same envelope. It is the filter sibling of #28172 (measures, merged in #28210) and #28201 (dimensions, in flight) on the same preview seam. Expected `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`.

Unmeasured, same seam: the structured-JSON dimension door (`assertDimensionsGroupScalarColumns`, #20807) is asked by the live `ensureCube` and not by the preview. Triage may fold it here or leave it.

## Dedupe

Read the open titles for `preview`, `runtimeFilter`, `dataset`: #28201 (dimensions) and #28194 (currency guard), neither the filter. **New.**

Links: #28172, #28201, #5669, #20807.
